scope: OSS2 final spatial M12+M3 versus plainR50, explicit FOUR classes mapped from original [0,2,3,4]. New architecture on the historical fold0, NOT a new blind test. Evaluation: 378 queries, 369 ships, five pass groups. Reference bank: 32 actual source-fit identities, eight per class. Plain has NO reference contribution. Full versus plain includes architecture and training-objective differences; no pure-architecture or physical-causality claim. Fit160/adapt96 steps per chain. Seeds17/29/43 change order under shared initialization, NOT three independent initializations. OA/BA are percent; deltas are percentage points; NLL is natural log; Brier sums FOUR classes. BA averages present classes only; absent groups are blank. SD is sample SD across three orders. Paired pass bootstrap resamples five whole passes and averages paired fixed-seed differences; its interval is conditional on these fitted models and only five clusters, not a training-uncertainty CI. Repeated observations, seeds and references are not independent evidence. Validation228/selection194 are recorded available only; no checkpoint selection. Outcome-selected native cases do not estimate population proportions; generated images remain not_reviewed.
